Late Every Time and Customer Service Inefficient. Have ordered through the app multiple times now and both times the delivery was late (like over an hour outside the scheduled window) and required a phone call to customer service to find out what was going on. Unlike with other apps (like Noon), you have to schedule your delivery the day before which theoretically should allow them plenty of time to make arrangements. When I called customer service, they explained that they would file a complaint then tried to get off the phone without giving me any information. When I asked why he could not check what was happening with the order while I was on the phone, he explained that he could not call the driver and that his only recourse was to email the store who would eventually call the driver, who would eventually update the store who would eventually update the customer service agent (hopefully within two hours) would eventually update me. In the meantime, the refrigerated perishables I ordered would presumably just be on the bike with the driver in the Emirati sun. It is difficult to imagine a less efficient system. Also, have had a history of mistakes with the order and a very tedious customer service process for addressing those issues as well. Also, the app glitches and will show you an error message sometimes for hours on end when you are trying to check on status of orders. Groceries are fairly priced and decent quality, so it really is a shame they can’t seem to put a more streamlined and functional system in place.

Horrible user experience. So, found a food item online that Carrefour was selling, clicked on it and was redirected to the app. 
When adding the item plus a couple of other things I was ready to check out. 

The app asked me to log in, register or continue with either Google or Apple. I had accidentally clicked on the “enter email” form, but decided to use the Apple login instead, but the keyboard then had popped up above the Apple login option, and clicking “DONE” did absolutely nothing, so that was no longer an option. 

So went ahead with Google, used my Google login and was asked to enter the location. Using the map location, I noticed that wherever the pointer was on the map, it suggested a location a few hundred meters away. Ok, fine, managed to find my location eventually. 

Then, I was asked to complete my profile. Entered my number, (the app had my birthdate already, so it must have recognized my email from Google and pulled up the information they had of me in their database), and then clicked “Proceed”. However, it said the number was already registered. 

Here is where I got stuck. There is no back button, no option to choose another type of login or anything else, basically you’re stuck on this screen. 

I force closed the app, clicked the browser link, and was again redirected to the app, and the same prompt came up to complete the profile with no other option. 

This is as far as I came. 

The people behind this app do not know what they’re doing, cheap developers with little experience in how to build smooth onboarding and user experiences, and a very low quality assurance testing. 

Interestingly enough, same garbage when using their website. There I’m using my Share login, and despite that I’m asked to complete a profile, which I cannot get out of, despite having had confirmed my phone number earlier in the checkout process. 
After I had entered my location during the checkout, after the login, it suggested a different location, which again is poor development. The cart was also emptied when I clicked backwards, so they don’t even have the caching and cookies down right. 

This is horrible for a shopping app that’s dependent on it being easy for customers to use. 

Instead of waiting for the food items to arrive, I’m now wasting my time writing this to earn others. 

There are plenty of other apps that are far better than this malfunctioning garbage.
